_comment: Paste this into the 'Job order created' webhook, or POST it to /webhook/meridian-job-order. Bullhorn shape: nested address, publicDescription, owner. Note skillList is DELIBERATELY EMPTY - this is the common case, and it is what makes the AI reader earn its place. Set AI_API_KEY in config and the required skills come out of the prose instead.
title: Forklift Operator
publicDescription: Distribution centre in Calder City is hiring experienced forklift operators for first shift, Monday to Friday, 6am to 2:30pm. Sit-down and stand-up reach trucks. RF scanner experience preferred. OSHA certification a plus. Must be able to lift 50lbs and pass a background check.
